name: state-reset
description: After generating an initial equilibrium state, it is common to reset displacements, velocities, and histories before starting the construction or excavation stage.
notes: Reset only the state variables that are artificial products of initialization; do not reset physical stress or pore-pressure state unless intended.
Save an initial-equilibrium state before staged model changes.
FLAC2D requires 'model large-strain on' (or off) before any solve / cycle command.
Displacement and velocity are nodal vector quantities → use 'zone gridpoint initialize' (NOT 'zone initialize').
FLAC2D vector tuple is (x,y); FLAC3D is (x,y,z).
Changing from one non-null constitutive model to another preserves zone stresses.
Assigning null removes stresses in affected zones.

examples.command:
model large-strain on
model solve elastic
zone gridpoint initialize displacement (0,0)
zone gridpoint initialize velocity (0,0)
model save 'initial-equilibrium'

model large-strain on
zone cmodel assign elastic
model solve elastic
zone cmodel assign mohr-coulomb range group 'stage'
zone property friction 35 cohesion 1e5 range group 'stage'
